title: director.location/1 (docs/director/location-variety-plan.md, as built)
description: data/director/location.json: where the fight roams between exchanges (sim/director/location.gd, DirLocation.roam): the hero's variety trigger, the destination scoring weights, whether the sea is a destination, the villain's prowl, and which biomes can be destinations per role. As built: the variety term is SIGNED (a destination biome over its planet share costs varietyW times the excess, one under it draws by varietyW times the deficit); prowlAfter is the fight's total seconds away from towns (the prowl also runs only while towns hold less than their planet share); the 20 s of recorded fight before shares count (MIN_RECORD) is a code constant, so there is deliberately no key for it and the closed schema rejects one. Planet shares come from WorldBiomes.SEG at load, not from data. The file is hashed (DirData.dataHash). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

excessStart.description: How far a biome's time share must exceed its planet share before the hero leaves it.

varietyW.description: Signed weight on a destination biome's share against its planet share: cost = varietyW x excess over the share, draw = varietyW x deficit under it.

keepW.description: The discount for the way a fighter already moves (today's LURE_KEEP).

oceanSurface.description: Lets the sea be a destination (the surface only).

prowlTier.description: The villain's prowl starts at this power tier.

prowlAfter.description: The fight's total seconds away from towns before the villain prowls (the prowl also needs towns below their planet share).
